originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge comparison of mathematically equivalent statements and possible stronger coverage, including Resultary semantic search, relevant published repository search, and primary literature readings. An adjoint pair of update matrices M and M^T yields a squared normality defect as the exact order-sampling gap. Prior PSD matrix-product inequalities apply to symmetric positive factors, unlike nonsymmetric GDA coupled maps; those inequalities cannot be substituted to deduce the reversed sign. Das et al. give K-epoch convergence bounds with step-size choices that may depend on K and n; those estimates do not order the two exact expected squared distances after one fixed two-step epoch. No stronger one-epoch theorem covering this opposite-coupling class was found in the searched material. Residual priority risks are recorded rather than treating negative searches as novelty proofs.
